title: urban-energy: the energy productivity of neighbourhood form
description: Pipeline and analysis code for 'The energy productivity of neighbourhood form: everyday access per unit of energy across England'. Measures household energy (metered gas and electricity plus NTS-anchored car travel) against network-based everyday access for 178,353 English Census 2021 Output Areas, with the access-per-kilowatt-hour rate between them and decarbonisation-scenario analysis.
